Dad: What were you doing when it rained?
Eva: I was practicing tennis with Jo.
Dad: Did you stay outside?
Eva: No, we went to the hall.
Dad: Were you watching a film there?
Eva: At first, yes, a short training video. Then I joined a drawing group.
Dad: What were you drawing?
Eva: A court. Sam was explaining the rules while I drew.
Dad: Did you go back out at four?
Eva: No, practice finished then.
Dad: What did you enjoy most?
Eva: Helping a new pupil understand the score.
